D153 authenticated whole-business erasure only, under caller writer exclusion/FK child-first order: walk the verified leading business index once without timeline sorting, through a non-holdable ordinary-heap cursor, and delete exact owner/table-OID-checked 4096-TID pages. Each actual DELETE plan must be TID-only; returned input keys are captured transactionally. Bounds, late FK or plan failure roll back all pages; GLOBAL shared input reference proof remains mandatory. No ordinary retention or age pruning authority. Outer exact-TID deletes retain a non-indexable exact owner residual and keep internal FK index scans enabled; the actual outer plan, table OID and removed-row count remain mandatory.
